features.name: Large self-propelled launch weapon, with interchangeable mission warheads called blocks. It is the missile body/system, not a handheld launcher.
Description and tables establish multiple payload configurations but no labeled exterior art, measurements, fin layout or exposed internals.

Root inspected the prepared overlay against the single accepted raw pair. Paired silhouette and landmarks remain aligned; each source mask retains its own components/openings, with no discarded components or filled holes. Thin members and structural openings retained. Fine grooves/seams are nonblocking. Native1254 images retained;2048 is resampled, not native2K. Root inspected actual assembled Outlaw BlockIII detail against Arsenal125/PDF127 and compiled195/PDF197. One complete self-propelled missile exterior,closed pointed nose,continuous covered body,four-fin tail interpreted with three visible fins/occluded fourth and dark rear exhaust recess. BlockIII selected explicitly;no mixing other block payloads/torpedo,exposed warhead,cutaway,launcher or active flight. Exact silhouette,fin count/finish artistic,not an own labeled design drawing or claim all blocks share one exterior. Entire nose/tail/fins framed,transparent,no floor/shadow. Single root final pair review: actual returned detailed/clay references inspected for paired silhouette,framing,state,major construction and openings;actual alpha diagnostics show one component/no holes and clear frame margins in each role. No opaque background,cast shadow or structural redesign. Shallow channels are nonblocking.
